prompt:
A delivery cyclist traveled a route at an average speed of $15.250$ miles per hour. What was this average speed, in yards per hour? $( 1 mile = 1,760 yards )$

$$0$$

$$26840$$
explanation: The correct answer is $26840$. It's given that $1 \text{ mile} = 1{,}760 \text{ yards}$. It follows that an average speed of $15.250$ miles per hour is equivalent to $\left( \frac{15.250 \text{ miles}}{1 \text{ hour}} \right) \left( \frac{1{,}760 \text{ yards}}{1 \text{ mile}} \right)$, or $26{,}840$ yards per hour.
